text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By now, Eishin Flash has a number of victories under her belt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I'm sorting through her race history, I realize something…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So I have won two G1 races at the Tokyo Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: G1 races are no easy undertaking to begin with. On top of that, it's incredible to think she's won twice on the same racecourse.
choice_data_list: You must be good with Tokyo.
You must be good with Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No, apologies. I understand that you are talking about the venue itself, but I found your phrasing humorous.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I don't think I am good with Tokyo at all…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: On the first day of my exchange program, I traveled from the airport to the academy's closest station on my own.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I was told someone would be there to meet me, but I was confident in my ability to follow the directions to the school.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I left the airport and found the station in the terminal without issue.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However… that is where I became lost. A map of the station building was not included in the route itinerary.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, the station was crammed with shops in each direction, causing me to become disoriented…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I was so flustered, I started speaking to a station attendant in German.
choice_data_list: It's hard for me to picture you getting lost.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That was the one and only time, though. From then on, I made a point to photograph building maps for future reference.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So to suddenly be told I am "good with Tokyo" is a very interesting turn of events.
choice_data_list: Now you can say you are with pride.
Now you can say you are with pride.
